summary: MIDIMON, a utility firmware with no synth that turns the FM-1 into a MIDI monitor and router, shown in a green-terminal style. It can also act as a Bluetooth MIDI dongle between USB, TRS and BLE devices.
features: Monitors USB, TRS, USB host and both BLE roles at once
Log of the last 4096 messages in hex, words or both
KEYS, CC, channel and CLOCK views; finds stuck notes
Filters by source, channel and message type
THRU matrix routes any source to USB, BLE-P and BLE-C
USB host needs a powered hub; early status (0.5)

headings: a bluetooth midi dongle you already have
